fields.name: work_memory
fields.meaning: Game working memory (the game uses battery memory as extra RAM). Not the save itself; the live copy of the save image at 0x0B2E-0x0E21 and the live variables it is built from also sit here, but at power-on the game reloads them from the save slots below
fields.evidence: diffs across many saves (bytes change constantly outside the slots); boot code fd20:0155 loads a slot into 0x0B2E

fields.name: slotA_start_mark
fields.meaning: Start marker of save copy A, always 0x02; the copy is rejected if it differs
fields.evidence: write code fd20:002f, check code fd20:01dd; boot reads

fields.name: slotA_length
fields.meaning: Length of the save image that follows: 0x02F4 (756) bytes
fields.evidence: write code fd20:003a, check code fd20:01ed (used to find the end marker and checksum)

fields.name: save_image
fields.meaning: Save image (756 bytes), a byte-for-byte copy of the packed image at work memory 0x0B2E. Rows below give its fields at copy A
fields.evidence: pack code d446:0007 (AL=0) then fd20:000d copies 0x0B2E..0x0E21 here; natural save work 0x0B2E == 0x7003 (756/756 bytes equal)

fields.name: ms_deck1_type
fields.meaning: Mobile suit in deck slot 1: index into the suit catalogue (slots past the deck count hold 0). Observed suits: 29 (MS-06F), 2 (RX-75), 36 (MS-06M)
fields.evidence: init code d000:d075 stores the type; values match catalogue names in the cartridge table; live copy 0x1BBA packed by d446:0007

fields.name: ms_deck1_specs_a
fields.meaning: Fixed suit data copied from catalogue entry bytes +0x2A..+0x31; individual bytes not decoded
fields.evidence: init code d000:d075; byte-exact match against the cartridge for all three observed suits

fields.name: ms_deck1_specs_b
fields.meaning: Fixed suit data copied from catalogue entry bytes +0x34..+0x48 (the copy skips +0x32..+0x33); individual bytes not decoded
fields.evidence: init code d000:d075; byte-exact match against the cartridge for all three observed suits

fields.name: ms_deck1_part_count
fields.meaning: How many compatible-part entries are listed in the next field (0-6)
fields.evidence: init code d000:d075; observed 5

fields.name: ms_deck1_parts
fields.meaning: Catalogue indexes compatible with this suit (every entry whose key byte +0x49 equals the suit type + 1); unused tail is 0
fields.evidence: init code d000:d075; predicted lists match the stored bytes exactly (30, 31, 35, 52, 70)

fields.name: ms_deck1_runtime
fields.meaning: Battle state, cleared to zero when the record is built; zero in every observed save
fields.evidence: init code d000:d075 zeroes it; no other writer found

fields.name: ms_deck_count
fields.meaning: Number of mobile suits in the deck (3 in the observed saves)
fields.evidence: pack code d446:0007 (from 0x1CA6); matches the three filled deck records

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Money. Purchases are refused when the price is above it, purchases subtract from it, battle rewards add to it; kept between 0 and 9,999,999. Observed value: 2600
fields.evidence: pack code d446:0007 (from 0x1B96), price check d7f0:00e1, subtract d8d0:0036, add f5a0:00c9 with clamp 0x98967F

fields.name: unknown_b1e
fields.meaning: Unknown byte (copied from work 0x0B1E); 0 in every observed save
fields.evidence: pack code d446:0007; cleared at new game

fields.name: progress_level
fields.meaning: Progress level: the shop list only offers suits whose required level (catalogue byte +0x4F) is at or below this value; at load a value of 22 or more switches a game mode flag. 0 in the observed saves
fields.evidence: pack code d446:0007 (from 0x0A18), filter code dcf0:0016, boot code dd30:013d

fields.name: special_unlock_bits
fields.meaning: Bit flags that unlock special catalogue entries (bit 0 for entry 0x47, bit 1 for entry 0x46). 0 in the observed saves
fields.evidence: pack code d446:0007 (from 0x0B2A), filter code dcf0:00fa/0108

fields.name: ms_type_flags_a
fields.meaning: One byte per catalogue suit (76 entries): 1 = available. Entries whose part-key (catalogue +0x49) is 0 are flagged here once their level and requirement gates pass; a start-up input code sets all 76 to 1 together with 100000 money. Observed set: 0, 2, 10, 28, 36, 59
fields.evidence: pack code d446:0007 (from 0x0A72), filter code d000:cefb predicts the observed set exactly, boot code sets all to 1

fields.name: ms_type_flags_b
fields.meaning: One byte per catalogue suit (76 entries): 1 = available as a compatible part. Part-type entries (nonzero part-key +0x49) are flagged here under the same gates. Observed set: 29, 30, 35
fields.evidence: pack code d446:0007 (from 0x0ABE); filter code d000:cefb predicts the observed set exactly

fields.name: pilots
fields.meaning: Three pilot records of 0x72 (114) bytes: pilot n (1..3) at 0x718E + (n-1)*0x72. Rows below give pilot 1; pilots 2 and 3 use the same layout
fields.evidence: pack code d446:0007 (from 0x0E32, 0x156 bytes), registration code ecb0:00ce (record base 0x0E32 + pilot*0x72); diff of one-pilot vs two-pilot saves

fields.name: pilot1_registered
fields.meaning: 1 = this pilot slot is registered (0 = empty; empty slots keep Status and the COM/VS modes greyed out)
fields.evidence: diff (0->1 at registration for pilots 1 and 2); reviewer check: blank memory greys out modes

fields.name: pilot1_name
fields.meaning: Pilot name, up to 43 bytes, rest filled with 0xFF. Each hiragana character is the byte 0x26 followed by the half-width katakana code of the same sound (JIS X 0201), with a separate 0xDE for the voiced mark: "a" = 26 B1, "azo" = 26 B1 26 BF DE
fields.evidence: diff of two registered names

fields.name: pilot1_portrait
fields.meaning: Portrait chosen on the character select screen, 0-based in reading order (0 = top left, 3 = second row right)
fields.evidence: diff (0 and 3) against the select screen

fields.name: pilot1_age
fields.meaning: Age; also split by dice rolls over the four attack stats at registration
fields.evidence: diff (15 and 18) with age select and Status screens; registration code

fields.name: pilot1_career
fields.meaning: Career chosen at registration: 0 civilian, 1 MS cadet, 2 MS soldier, 3 space airman, 4 ground armour, 5 navy sailor; decides the starting rank and stat rolls
fields.evidence: diff (0 and 1); registration code ecb0:0133 switches on values 0-5

fields.name: pilot1_rank
fields.meaning: Rank: 0 private 2nd class, 1 private 1st class; higher values not seen
fields.evidence: diff (0 and 1) with Status screens; registration code sets it per career

fields.name: pilot1_mission_ability
fields.meaning: Mission ability, shown on Status; always set to 50 at registration
fields.evidence: code ecb0 (stores 0x32); both pilots 50 on Status screens

fields.name: pilot1_personality
fields.meaning: Personality: 1 normal, 2 aggressive; rolled at registration
fields.evidence: code (dice roll); diff (2 and 1) with Status screens

fields.name: pilot1_intuition
fields.meaning: Intuition: a dice roll plus a career base (60/30/40)
fields.evidence: code; diff (61 and 39) with Status screens

fields.name: pilot1_piloting
fields.meaning: Piloting attack: a career base plus an age share
fields.evidence: code (base + age split); diff (5 and 11) with Status screens; base+shares add up exactly for both pilots

fields.name: pilot1_short_range
fields.meaning: Short-range attack: a career base plus an age share
fields.evidence: code; diff (3 and 10) with Status screens; sums check

fields.name: pilot1_mid_range
fields.meaning: Mid-range attack: a career base plus an age share
fields.evidence: code; diff (3 and 9) with Status screens; sums check

fields.name: pilot1_long_range
fields.meaning: Long-range attack: a career base plus an age share
fields.evidence: code; diff (4 and 8) with Status screens; sums check

fields.name: pilot1_aptitude
fields.meaning: Aptitude for space, ground, air, water, one byte each; a new pilot starts with 2 in all four, shown as C (careers 2-5 improve one to 1)
fields.evidence: registration code (sets all four to 2); Status shows C for all; other letters unobserved

fields.name: pilot1_ms_potential
fields.meaning: Potential per suit family, 16 bytes, all 0 for a new pilot (career 2 may set one to 0x14)
fields.evidence: registration code (clears 16 bytes); Status page 2 all 0

fields.name: pilot1_unknown_4b
fields.meaning: Unknown, 0 for a new pilot; bit 7 of the first byte gates special catalogue entries
fields.evidence: registration code clears it; filter code d000:cefb reads bit 7 for entries whose +0x4E is 0x0F

fields.name: pilot1_battle_counters
fields.meaning: Battle-result counters cleared at registration (one word, four words, three words, two bytes); writers not traced
fields.evidence: registration code ed10:011c-01a8 clears them, then saves

fields.name: boot_counter_b0a
fields.meaning: Boot counter: raised by one at every power-on (1 in the observed saves; reset to 0 at new game)
fields.evidence: boot code dd30 (increments 0x0B0A); pack code copies it; diffs

fields.name: unknown_a4c
fields.meaning: Unknown byte copied from work 0x0A4C (0 in every observed save)
fields.evidence: pack code d446:00c1, cleared at new game

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Text "GUNDAM MSVS V12" plus a zero byte, copied from the cartridge; compared after loading, a mismatch makes the game start fresh
fields.evidence: pack code d446:00cb (copy from cartridge), boot code dd30:010c (compare after load)

fields.name: slotA_end_mark
fields.meaning: End marker, always 0x03
fields.evidence: write code fd20:0076, check code fd20:01fb; boot reads

fields.name: slotA_checksum
fields.meaning: CRC-16/KERMIT (reflected polynomial 0x1021 i.e. 0x8408, start value 0, no final xor; check value of "123456789" = 0x2189) over 0x7001..0x72F7 (length, image and end marker, 0x2F7 bytes); stored low byte first. One-pilot saves: 0x9C51
fields.evidence: recomputed over every observed save (104 valid copies, 0 broken); code d000:0543 (tables d000:0583/0683), write fd20:0085, check fd20:021f

fields.name: unused_a
fields.meaning: Not written by the game (zero)
fields.evidence: diffs (zero)

fields.name: slotB_copy
fields.meaning: Copy B: same layout as copy A (0x7800 start mark, 0x7801 length, 0x7803 image, 0x7AF7 end mark, 0x7AF8 checksum); written right after copy A and used when copy A fails its checks
fields.evidence: write code fd20:00bb (DL=1), load code fd20:017c (fallback); A == B in every valid save

fields.name: unused_b
fields.meaning: Not written by the game (zero)
fields.evidence: diffs (zero)

fields.name: not_save_data
fields.meaning: The 128-byte console internal EEPROM carries no save data for this game: identical in every observed save
fields.evidence: all observed images byte-identical; game code only reads words 0x30-0x3B
